headline: MSc. in Finance | investments | Corporate Finance | Management | MBA | Strategic formulation |
about:
Profesional en Finanzas y Comercio Exterior, Magister en Administración Financiera.
Cuento con más de 9 años de experiencia dedicados al manejo integral de procesos financieros, analítica de datos, económicos, bursátiles, comerciales y administrativos; valoración de proyectos, análisis de riesgos financieros, mejoramiento organizacional. 
Me destaco por ser innovadora y recursiva, gestionar portafolios de inversión y procesos administrativos y financieros en empresas del sector real y bursátil a nivel nacional e internacional.

Puedes contactarme a paola.vargas@scendere.com 
-----------------
I Have a Master's Degree in Financial Administration to complement my career in Finance and international Trade, which has supported more than 9 years of leadership in the integral management of statistical, economic, stock market, administrative and accounting processes; project valuation, financial risk analysis, organizational improvement, relationship with investment banks, fiduciaries, commissioning firms and commercial banks.

Throughout this period, I have acquired skills for improving the customer experience; innovative and resourceful professional, with competencies managing investment portfolios and administrative and financial processes in companies of the real and stock market sector at a national and international level.
